settings.text: Here's what cat parents actually experience with Buckley:

settings.repere: Paragraphe · This is when most cat parents notice the
settings.text: This is when most cat parents notice the first shift. Less sneezing. Fewer tissues. You realize you woke up without congestion for the first time in months. Published research confirms a significant reduction in active allergens starting at week 3.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The difference becomes undeniable. Your
settings.text: The difference becomes undeniable. Your cat is on your lap and you're not reaching for an inhaler. Guests with allergies visit and don't sneeze. One customer told us: 'His symptoms are 95% gone. We were thinking about rehoming our cats.'

settings.repere: Paragraphe · This is where Buckley customers say it f
settings.text: This is where Buckley customers say it feels life-changing. The allergen levels in your home have steadily dropped. Your cat sleeps on the bed again. You stop thinking about allergies altogether and start just enjoying your cat. *Individual timelines vary*
